Dead Signal 0.6.1

A technician trapped in a biotech lab gone wrong fights his way to the top floor, and down to the bottom of it. Built from beginning to end (packs/ds-*): Floor 1, Lockdown; Floor 2, Synthid Research; Floor 3, Gestation; Floor 4, the Proving Grounds; Floors 5 and 5a, the Executive Floor and the board’s own; Sub-level B, Tartarus; and back up to the boardroom, and the endings. The Dead Signal Laboratory, The Complex and The Sterile Annex follow them as placeholders. games/dead-signal/DESIGN.md has the plan.

To play, open index.html in a browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari). It needs a keyboard and mouse.
Made with the Linear Maze engine (engine/). The game itself is in games/dead-signal/.
